description: Implementation of NextcloudBackend class for synchronizing notes with Nextcloud server, including network status checks, note creation, update, deletion, and retrieval.

classes.name: NextcloudBackend
classes.description: Handles synchronization with Nextcloud, including network status, note CRUD operations, and caching.

methods.name: isAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the Nextcloud server is available, with caching to reduce network calls.

methods.name: createNote
methods.description: Creates a new note on the Nextcloud server.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates an existing note on the Nextcloud server.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes a note on the Nextcloud server.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Retrieves a specific note from Nextcloud.
